population: Swedish advertised procurements with reported post-award data; supplier-size bidder table excludes individual-person bidder data and differs from total bids table
evidence_limitations: Bids per bidder describe participation intensity, not market size, supplier spend, ability to pay or impact of AgentMine.
After-advertised coverage is 63.7%; selection and missing-outcome bias can distort competition metrics.
Supplier-size classes follow Statistics Sweden employee-count rules, not EU turnover/balance-sheet definitions.
The 71,128 bids in bidder-size table exclude certain personal-data bidder records and must not be equated with the broader 74,133 bids total.
The 2025 non-bidder survey and 2024 bidder-size table have different populations; no cross-dataset causal inference.
No AgentMine pilot, verified customer, revenue, conversion or unit cost observed.
hypothesis_to_test: Recruit opt-in micro/small firms with prior tender experience to measure whether a requirement-extraction and bid/no-bid workflow saves verifiable analyst time. Compare repeated usage and paid pilot conversion against large-firm baseline; do not treat participation gap as proof of willingness to pay.
